title: sched/nxevent: add support of kernel event group
problem_statement: NuttX lacks a kernel event group primitive. PR #12802 adds a new event API (nx_event_init, nx_event_post, nx_event_wait, nx_event_reset, nx_event_destroy) declared in include/nuttx/event.h and implemented in sched/event/. The feature is gated behind CONFIG_SCHED_EVENTS=y. Apps PR #2458 adds nxevent.c to ostest which exercises this new API. On the base kernel commit, event.h does not exist, so nxevent.c fails to compile.
fail_reason: include/nuttx/event.h does not exist at base kernel commit — nxevent.c fails with fatal error: nuttx/event.h: No such file or directory
fail_to_pass: build succeeds without compile errors in nxevent.c
ostest completes and exits with status 0
pass_to_pass: NuttX boots and NSH prompt appears
